_help: Each printed Bible-donate sign gets a unique id and a QR code that points at donate.html?sign=<id>. The Apps Script handler stores sign_id on the Bibles row so we can correlate which signs convert. To add a new sign: append an entry below, then run scripts/generate_sign_qr_codes.py to (re)generate the SVGs in assets/images/sign-qr/. Retire a sign by setting retired_at to today's ISO date — the entry stays in the file as an audit record.
